isolation: Each scenario's state was made through the app's own interface or API on its own far-future date (Dec 2026) and asserted on the change or on that date's busy times. The app has no container to own, so assertions are on those dates only. GET /me/bookings returns 500, so 'Asha holds no upcoming bookings' was held by cancelling every booking test-member made (each DELETE returned 204), not by reading her list. One mistaken booking (Borealis 2026-12-08 11:00-14:00) was made while driving and cancelled straight away. Scenarios needing the clock set to 10:00 could not be established on the real clock and are blocked.
